```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(stringr)
library(readxl)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(readr)
```

#Read in all the files in the raw data folder 
```{r}
files <- list.files(path = "2021 Raw Data", full.names = TRUE)

# 3. Read and combine all CSVs
all_data <- files %>%
    lapply(function(file) {
    df <- read_excel(file, col_types = "text", range = cell_limits(c(6, 1), c(NA, 10)))
    return(df)
  }) %>%
  bind_rows() %>% 
  rename(Collection_Date = `Collection Date`, 
         Run_Date = `Run Date`, 
         Grid_Square = `Grid Square`, 
         Sample_ID = `Sample ID`, 
         CH4_Area = `CH4 Peak Area`, 
         CO2_Area = `CO2 Peak Area`, 
         CH4_ppm = `CH4 (ppm)`, 
         CO2_ppm = `CO2 (ppm)`) %>% 
  mutate(Collection_Date = as.Date(as.numeric(Collection_Date), origin = "1899-12-30")) %>% 
  mutate(Run_Date = as.Date(as.numeric(Run_Date), origin = "1899-12-30")) 

```


##Calculate umol/L from ppm
```{r}

# Convert ppm CH4 to total umol CH4 in the sample headspace
# use Ideal Gas Law:  
#   hdsp umol CH4 = ppm CH4*(PV/RT) 
#      P = 1 (pressure in atm)
#      R = 0.082 (gas constant)
#      V = 0.015 (gas syringe volume in L)
#      T = "TempC" column value in Kelvin (equilibration temperature)

#set the volume used for the sample
# volume = 0.02 L vial
# TempC <-  25 #I am assuming 25C not sure how we want to handle this



all_data1 <- all_data %>% 
  mutate(CH4_uM = )


Samples$CH4_Conc_umol <- ifelse(Samples$G_W == "W",
                    ((Samples$CH4_Conc_ppm_dilcorr*((1*volume/1000)/(0.08206*(TempC+273.15))))/(volume/1000)),
                    ((((Samples$CH4_Conc_ppm_dilcorr/1000))/16.04)*1000000  ))
Samples$CO2_Conc_umol <- ifelse(Samples$G_W == "W",
                    ((Samples$CO2_Conc_ppm_dilcorr*((1*volume/1000)/(0.08206*(TempC+273.15))))/(volume/1000)),
                    ((((Samples$CO2_Conc_ppm_dilcorr/1000))/16.04)*1000000  )) ##This should be 44.01! 

```


```{r}
##Calculate mean of CO2 data for each Plot
##Make columns 18 to 21 numeric
all_data <- all_data %>%
  mutate(across(18:21, ~as.numeric(as.character(.))))

C_mean_CO2 = mean(subset(all_data, Sample_Plot == "Control")$CO2_Conc_ppm_dilcorr, na.rm = TRUE)
F_mean_CO2 = mean(subset(all_data, Sample_Plot == "Freshwater")$CO2_Conc_ppm_dilcorr, na.rm = TRUE)
S_mean_CO2 = mean(subset(all_data, Sample_Plot == "Seawater")$CO2_Conc_ppm_dilcorr, na.rm = TRUE)
GCW_TR_mean_CO2 = mean(subset(all_data, Sample_Plot == "Transition")$CO2_Conc_ppm_dilcorr, na.rm = TRUE)

##Flag data that is more than 100x the mean 
all_data <- all_data %>% 
  mutate(qaqc_flag = NA) %>% 
  mutate(qaqc_flag = case_when(
    is.na(qaqc_flag) & Sample_Plot == "Control" & CO2_Conc_ppm_dilcorr >= 10*C_mean_CO2 ~ "CO2 unusually high, not real value",
    is.na(qaqc_flag) & Sample_Plot == "Freshwater" & CO2_Conc_ppm_dilcorr >= 10*F_mean_CO2 ~ "CO2 unusually high, not real value",
    is.na(qaqc_flag) & Sample_Plot == "Seawater" & CO2_Conc_ppm_dilcorr >= 10*S_mean_CO2 ~ "CO2 unusually high, not real value",
    is.na(qaqc_flag) & Sample_Plot == "Transition" & CO2_Conc_ppm_dilcorr >= 10*GCW_TR_mean_CO2 ~ "CO2 unusually high, not real value",
    TRUE ~ qaqc_flag    # NA if no match
  ))

##Calculate mean of CH4 data for each Site
C_mean_CH4 = mean(subset(all_data, Sample_Plot = "Control")$CH4_Conc_ppm_dilcorr, na.rm = TRUE)
F_mean_CH4 = mean(subset(all_data, Sample_Plot == "Freshwater")$CH4_Conc_ppm_dilcorr, na.rm = TRUE)
S_mean_CH4 = mean(subset(all_data, Sample_Plot == "Seawater")$CH4_Conc_ppm_dilcorr, na.rm = TRUE)
GCW_TR_mean_CH4 = mean(subset(all_data, Sample_Plot == "Transition")$CH4_Conc_ppm_dilcorr, na.rm = TRUE)

##Flag data that is more than 100x the mean 
all_data <- all_data %>% 
  mutate(qaqc_flag = case_when(
    Sample_Plot == "Control" & CH4_Conc_ppm_dilcorr >= 10*C_mean_CH4 ~ paste0(qaqc_flag, " CH4 unusually high, not real value"),
    is.na(qaqc_flag) & Sample_Plot == "Freshwater" & CH4_Conc_ppm_dilcorr >= 10*F_mean_CH4 ~ paste0(qaqc_flag, " CH4 unusually high, not real value"),
    is.na(qaqc_flag) & Sample_Plot == "Seawater" & CH4_Conc_ppm_dilcorr >= 10*S_mean_CH4 ~ paste0(qaqc_flag, " CH4 unusually high, not real value"),
    is.na(qaqc_flag) & Sample_Plot == "Transition" & CH4_Conc_ppm_dilcorr >= 10*GCW_TR_mean_CH4 ~ paste0(qaqc_flag, " CH4 unusually high, not real value"),
    TRUE ~ qaqc_flag    # NA if no match
  ))

```


## Write the 2021 file out to the folder 
```{r, echo=FALSE}

##Remove Synoptic Data
final_data <- all_data %>% 
    filter(Sample_Plot != "Transition")

write.csv(final_data, "COMPASS_TEMPEST_SGAS_2023.csv")

```
